Four merged PRs since 2026-04-16 changed the body of `handleFormSubmission`. Newest first:

1. **PR #3639**, "Preserve medication dosage drafts when switching modes", merged 2026-10-05. It nulls the free-text fields in the basket item and wraps `onSave` in a try/catch. @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.component.tsx:329-359}
2. **PR #3507**, "Order basket should try to rely on server-side dates", merged 2026-07-24. It replaces the start-date snap with `getOrderStartDateForSubmission`, which resolves to `scheduledDate`. @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.component.tsx:305-309}
3. **PR #2973**, "Add support for future medication start dates", merged 2026-05-26 (+05:30; 2026-05-25 in UTC). It adds the future-revision check with `setError` and the early return. @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.component.tsx:308-327}
4. **PR #3300**, "Floor medication order encounter datetime to visit start", merged 2026-05-12. It introduces the `startDate` snap at the top of the function. @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/drug-order-form.component.tsx:305-309}

The function is at `drug-order-form.component.tsx:305-360` at the pinned head. The local checkout and the default branch both contain the PR #3639 and PR #3507 changes, so I took it as the pinned head.

Commits touching the file since 2026-04-16 that I ruled out because their hunks lie outside the function: #3793 (labels), #3596 (pinned-drug notification), #3348 (recalculate quantity), #3353 (launch allergy form), #3422 (number-input wrappers), #3198 (datepicker `minDate` and TODO removal), and the 2026-05-12 style cleanup (`e86881c`, datepicker and button classes).

The dates are commit dates from `list_commits`. These are squash merges, so I took them as merge dates. I did not check PR merge timestamps directly.
